name: Ever Supreme Bio Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Ever Supreme Bio Technology Co., Ltd engages in the research, development, and manufacture of drug products related to human mesenchymal stem cells and immune cells in Taiwan. The company operates through two segments: Cell Preparation Business and Other Operating Business segments. The company's products include umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells, a drug candidate in Phase I clinical trials for the treatment of myocardial infarction and stroke.
